method.automated: NFKC plus punctuation/whitespace removal; screen every paragraph for contiguous overlaps of 8 or more normalized characters and reference markers. Threshold is a review trigger, not a legal infringement standard. Both datasets use simplified Chinese; no full traditional/simplified transliteration or semantic paraphrase detection.
method.targetedInspection: 42 flagged paragraphs read in full; 62 additional distinct quoted spans inspected as ordinary dialogue; supplementary attribution-marker hits inspected as ordinary contexts.
method.disposition: Omit every flagged embedded-reference paragraph and both short occupation-list overlaps, without claiming those passages infringe. Retain eight confirmed ordinary-context false positives. No excluded text is reproduced in this policy.
method.limitations: Pinned 1848-entry corpus is not the entire Tianji course or all third-party works. This is a conservative technical content review, not proof of ownership or a legal opinion.
